answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 11300 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: According to hadeeth we have to read surah mulk and sajdah between Isha & Maghrib.So will it be enough if we read it in Awwabeen Salah? (2) Is it halal to play chess or carroms without keeping bet? Question: According to hadeeth we have to read surah mulk and sajdah between Isha & Maghrib.So will it be enough if we read it in Awwabeen Salah? (2) Is it halal to play chess or carroms without keeping bet? Answer ID: 11300 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 534/534=M/1430) Yes, it will be enough. (2) It is makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
